issues.description: Method name inconsistency in Farm: the task text (problem_statement.md, lines 112-114) instructs students to implement a method named printFarmSong() in Farm.java, but both the template and the reference solution define a public method named singFarmSong() instead (template: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 9; solution: src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 59). Additionally, the UML in the problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 16-21) references a private singFarmSong(animal):void helper. This mismatch between the name used in the textual task (printFarmSong) and the identifier present in the codebase (singFarmSong) can confuse students about which method to implement or modify and where to place the song logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) update the problem statement and UML to ask for singFarmSong() (and document its purpose), or (B) rename the template and solution methods from singFarmSong() to printFarmSong(), and update all references (including Main, UML, and any tests). Ensure the chosen name is used consistently in the textual instructions, UML, template stubs, and reference solution so students clearly know which method to implement.
